texture_prompt.text: Fictional LC-01 lunar industrial game prop. Off-white ceramic-coated armor panels over dark blue-grey metal chassis, dark rubber grip, one saturated orange removable energy cell, exactly three narrow cyan emissive energy bands. Clean readable large material regions with very restrained edge wear. Neutral albedo without baked lighting or painted highlights. Preserve the existing geometry, openings, part boundaries and UV layout wherever supported. No extra objects, no camouflage, no heavy dirt, no ornamental engraving.
